title: Enrollment confirmation
description: Confirm a course enrollment with start date and access link. Booking confirmation WhatsApp template for schools and online courses.
notes: Include start date and where classes happen. Utility approval relies on it confirming a student action.

body.text: Congratulations {{first_name}}, you're enrolled in *{{course}}* at {{school}}. Classes start on {{date}}, and your login details are on the way.
